answer_1.quote: Leveraging large language models (LLMs), we developed a framework to characterize stigma based on conceptualization of (labeling, stereotyping, separation, status loss, and discrimination) and transform them into more empathetic versions, resulting in 1,649 de-stigmatized pairs.
datasets: Reddit posts from r/unpopularopinion, r/offmychest, r/medicine, r/nursing

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation. To further evaluate the stylistic similarity between original posts and their de-stigmatized counterparts generated by our models, we conducted a linguistic analysis using LIWC.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. To assess the effectiveness of our six systems ... we conducted a human evaluation with five reviewers ...
answer_4.guideline: Assess the overall quality of the generated text with respect to ... naturalness, cohesion, human-likeness, and overall coherence ... de-stigmatization ... faithfulness ...
